provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Word family ad
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify words with ad sound.
The pupils should be able to blend and read ad words.
Introduction:
We have learned letter sounds. Today we learn words with ad sound.
Content:
ad words are bad, dad, had, mad, pad.
Each word ends with ad sound.
Blend the letters b-a-d to make bad.
Class activity:
Children will make flashcards and read them aloud.
Evaluation questions:
What sound do these words end with?
Can you read this word?
Summary:
We can read words with ad sound.

topics.title: Word family ap
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify ap words.
The pupils should be able to match ap words to pictures.
Introduction:
We learned ad words. Now we learn ap words.
Content:
ap words are cap, lap, map, nap, tap.
Each word ends with ap sound.
A cap is what we wear on our head.
Class activity:
Children will match word cards to picture cards.
Evaluation questions:
What is this word?
Match this word to its picture.
Summary:
We can read and match ap words.

topics.title: Word family ig
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read ig words.
The pupils should be able to listen to the pig story.
Introduction:
We learned ap words. Today we learn ig words.
Content:
ig words are big, dig, pig, wig.
Each word ends with ig sound.
A pig is a farm animal that says oink oink.
Class activity:
Teacher will read a story about a pig with ig words.
Evaluation questions:
What sound do these words end with?
What animal is in the story?
Summary:
We can read ig words and listen to stories.

topics.title: Word family in
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify in words.
The pupils should be able to match words to pictures.
Introduction:
We learned ig words. Now we learn in words.
Content:
in words are bin, fin, pin, tin, win.
Each word ends with in sound.
A bin is where we put trash.
Class activity:
Children will pin word cards to matching picture cards.
Evaluation questions:
What is this word?
Pin this word to its picture.
Summary:
We can read and match in words.

topics.title: Word family og
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read og words.
The pupils should be able to clap syllables in og words.
Introduction:
We learned in words. Today we learn og words.
Content:
og words are dog, fog, log, jog.
Each word ends with og sound.
A dog is a pet that barks.
Class activity:
Children will read og words and clap for each syllable.
Evaluation questions:
What sound do these words end with?
Clap the syllables in this word.
Summary:
We can read og words and clap syllables.

topics.title: Word family ot
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read ot words.
The pupils should be able to write ot words.
Introduction:
We learned og words. Now we learn ot words.
Content:
ot words are cot, dot, hot, pot.
Each word ends with ot sound.
A pot is used for cooking in the kitchen.
Class activity:
Children will read ot words and write them on the board.
Evaluation questions:
What sound do these words end with?
Can you write this word?
Summary:
We can read and write ot words.

topics.title: Word family ug
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read ug words.
The pupils should be able to play the mug the bug game.
Introduction:
We learned ot words. Today we learn ug words.
Content:
ug words are bug, jug, mug, rug.
Each word ends with ug sound.
A bug is a small insect we see outside.
Class activity:
Children will play mug the bug game with word cards.
Evaluation questions:
What sound do these words end with?
Can you read this word?
Summary:
We can read ug words and play games.

topics.title: Word family un
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read un words.
The pupils should be able to play the read and run game.
Introduction:
We learned ug words. Now we learn un words.
Content:
un words are bun, fun, run, sun.
Each word ends with un sound.
The sun is in the sky during the day.
Class activity:
Children will read un words and run when they hear their word.
Evaluation questions:
What sound do these words end with?
Run when you hear your word.
Summary:
We can read un words and play games.

topics.title: Simple sentences
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read simple sentences.
The pupils should be able to follow along with the teacher.
Introduction:
We learned word families. Now we learn simple sentences.
Content:
Simple sentences are The cat sat. The dog ran.
Each sentence has a subject and a verb.
The cat is the subject. Sat is the verb.
Class activity:
Children will read sentences with the teacher.
Evaluation questions:
Can you read this sentence?
What is the verb in this sentence?
Summary:
We can read simple sentences.

topics.title: Revision and word contest
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read word family words.
The pupils should be able to participate in a word contest.
Introduction:
We learned many word families. Today we revise and play games.
Content:
We will review all word families from this term.
Children will play a word family relay game.
Class activity:
Children will play word family relay with word cards.
Evaluation questions:
Can you read this word?
Which word family does this word belong to?
Summary:
We can read many words and play games.
